content.rationale: The log verb: it reads each node's document and edges through M-node-set — the set read reaches M-node-load, which reads through M-store-read across the runner (M-jj) — and refuses when a node did not load (L), takes each node's summary from the change descriptions `jj log` supplies (M-jj-log), and emits O9's rendering — one `<id> <kind> <summary>` line per node — changing nothing and recording nothing, settling no filtering. The lines follow ztpwplsn's dependency order: each node comes after everything it depends on or evaluates, the smallest change id goes next when several are ready, and a cycle's leftovers follow last in ascending change id. The order is computed over the edges M-node-set already returned, so the set is not read twice. An argument at all refuses (C). It reads through the runner (M-jj) and returns its lines for the envelope to write (M-output-return) under M-route's handler shape, carrying its own --help text (xlvoxmyl/rwlywqrk, per M-help's division of labour) and the injected context (M-context-injection). I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. It takes the runner from the injected context (M-context). The read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn) is this invocation's: the set read is all-or-nothing, so one unreadable node refuses, naming it.
